location_description: Monfort Heights is a census-designated place (CDP) in Green Township, Hamilton County, Ohio, United States, part of the Cincinnati–Northern Kentucky metropolitan area. The population of Monfort Heights was 11,948 at the 2010 census. In previous censuses, the area was listed as two separate CDPs, Monfort Heights East and Monfort Heights South.
